svg.font-family: -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Three tiers of scorer, cheap to expensive
svg.desc: Programmatic scorers are free and run on every commit, an LLM judge costs a model call per case and runs nightly on a sample, and human review is the ground truth you calibrate against.
svg.text: The scorer ladder: put the cheapest gate first
Cost rises as you climb. Coverage rises too. The trick is which tier gates the merge and which runs nightly.
exact match, token F1, contains-required, declines-when-it-should
free, instant, deterministic. Runs on every commit and blocks the merge.
a scorer with a rubric, for what code cannot check (faithful? right tone?)
one model call per case. Runs nightly, on a sample. Must be calibrated first.
the ground truth every tier above is measured against
slow and dear. Spend it on the labels that calibrate the judge, not on grading everything.
